generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS ARE AS PER BID DOCUMENT

The Tenderer should upload the caste certificate in the prescribed format issued by GOK which is mandatory.The tenderer belonging to Schedule Caste or schedule Tribes shall be Domicile of the state of Karnataka for more than 10 years.If the contractor is a firm,then all the partners or members of the firm shall belong to the SC or ST as the case may be.
Contractors should have registration in BWSSB or KPWD/KUWSDB, etc. as per KTPP act and shall furnish valid registration certificate which is in currency
Assessed available tender capacity should be (AN5)-B should be greater than the amount put to tender(58.04 lakhs)
The form of tender as per the preform available in bid document should be duly filled and uploaded in the e-procurement portal as a part of tender document which is mandatory
Amount put to tender is excluding GST. Rates quoted shall be excluding GST

The tenderer should have in the last 5 years period achieved in at least ONE financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of rupees not less than the estimated cost under this contract Rs.58.04 lakhs. Turnover, Profit & Loss account, Balance sheet statement certified / audited by a Chartered Accountant along with UDIN No. to be submitted
The tenderer should have satisfactorily completed as prime contractor for atleast any construction work to an extent of 25% of the cost of this work (amount put to tender) Rs.14.51 lakhs
